## Before you start
- Take an issue only if it is marked `status: ready`. An issue marked `status: blocked` is waiting for the issues named above.
- Comment on this issue to ask for it, and wait to be assigned.
- One issue per pull request.
- There is no deadline. If you can no longer continue, please say so, so that it can be reassigned.
- See `CONTRIBUTING.md` for setup, tests and the claiming rules.

**Difficulty:** Beginner | Intermediate
